brightvale.title: The Founding Stone
brightvale.text: Here the first wanderers rested after the Sky Fell. They named the valley Brightvale, for the falling star lit it like noon for forty nights.

starfall.title: Stone of the Fallen Star
starfall.text: The star broke upon the land. Its tears, the mana crystals, scattered to the dark places, the high places and the forgotten places. Whoever gathers them gathers the star's memory.

braziers.title: Hill of Three Flames
braziers.text: Three flames for the three virtues of the old order: courage to begin, kindness to share, humility to listen. Light them, and the star's gift is yours.

pillar.title: The Sky Pillar
pillar.text: Before the Fall, the pillar held up the edge of the sky. Now it holds only the wind, and whatever the brave leave at its top.

cave.title: Miner's Warning
cave.text: Turn back. Something breathes in the deep. We sealed the lower tunnels and left the rest to the dark. (The letters are scratched by a shaking hand.)
